_comment: What tools/deps-watch.js compares every week (not shipped). 'reviewed' = the upstream value already looked at: when upstream changes, an issue is opened; after the review, write the new value here. 'local' = our copy, shown in the issue.

sources.name: HereBeDragons-2.0
sources.why: map library of GuildPositions / Transports, upstream copy (WoW Forever upstream since 35): a new version is taken whole (only the line endings change).

sources.name: CallbackHandler-1.0
sources.why: Ace3 callbacks (one copy in the main addon for the four addons).

sources.name: LibStub
sources.why: library loader (one copy in the main addon for the four addons).

sources.name: LibRangeCheck-3.0
sources.why: range of the battleground frames (PvP addon, fallback after the game's own checks); in the PvP addon's Libs (loaded with it), its two do-not-package blocks removed as its packager does.

sources.name: BattleGroundEnemies
sources.why: the PvP addon is BattleGroundEnemies (Bullsei) cleaned up: an upstream release can hold fixes to port.

sources.name: Blizzard UI Add-On Development Policy
sources.why: Blizzard's rules for addons (free, readable code, no harm to realms / players, no ads, no in-game donation request, Terms of Use).

sources.name: forever-bugs tracked issues
sources.why: community tracker of the game's bugs. 24: an invite or mail by full name can reach another character with the same first name (mass invites, InviteTool; /wl verify line invitename). 166: raid marks secret in combat, no way to draw them (PvP frames show none then). 267: raid buffs secret in combat (Raid Buffs reads out of combat). A state change: see what it means for the code.

sources.name: forever-bugs addon issues
sources.why: new reports whose title speaks of addons, the API, taint or secret values: a bug of the game can look like a bug of ours. reviewed = the newest such issue number already read.

sources.name: Luacheck
sources.why: the CI runs Luacheck 1.2.0 (signed binary, SHA-256 pinned in wlrt-ci.yml).
